## R可复现核心逻辑（供二次开发）

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
rand <- function(a,b) runif(1,a,b)
longTailRate <- function(){
  r <- runif(1)
  if(r<0.55) rand(0.005,0.06) else if(r<0.8) rand(0.06,0.18) else if(r<0.92) rand(0.18,0.35) else rand(0.35,0.78)
}
# 示例：生成90天同桌率
set.seed(2026)
base <- 0.08
daily <- purrr::map_dfr(1:90, function(i){
  if(runif(1)<0.08) base <<- base + rand(0.08,0.22) else base <<- base + rand(-0.006,0.006)
  base <<- max(0.01, min(0.55, base))
  same <- min(0.95, base*0.9 + longTailRate()*0.2 + rand(-0.02,0.02))
  cnt <- floor(rand(20,180*(1+base*2)))
  profit <- cnt*same*rand(8,18) - rand(0,80)
  roi <- profit/(cnt*5)
  tibble::tibble(day=i, same=same, cnt=cnt, profit=profit, roi=roi)
})
head(daily)
```

```{r}
#| label: chart-demo
#| fig-height: 5
plot_ly(daily, x=~day, y=~same, type='scatter', mode='lines', name='同桌率', line=list(color='#FF1744')) %>%
  add_lines(y=~roi, name='ROI', yaxis='y2', line=list(color='#7C4DFF', dash='dash')) %>%
  layout(title='主趋势·同桌率+ROI双轴示例 (R复现)', yaxis=list(title='同桌率'), yaxis2=list(overlaying='y', side='right', title='ROI'), plot_bgcolor='#0B1220', paper_bgcolor='#0B1220', font=list(color='white'))
```

## Python可复现核心逻辑

```{python}
#| label: py-demo
import random, math
def rand(a,b): return a + random.random()*(b-a)
def longTailRate():
    r=random.random()
    if r<0.55: return rand(0.005,0.06)
    if r<0.8: return rand(0.06,0.18)
    if r<0.92: return rand(0.18,0.35)
    return rand(0.35,0.78)
samples=[longTailRate() for _ in range(2000)]
print(f"均值 {sum(samples)/len(samples):.4f} 中位 {sorted(samples)[1000]:.4f}")
# pairData真值
pairData=[dict(a=273467,b=3163098,same=85,total=191,rate=0.445,tier="L4-实锤",days=54,score=3.8),
          dict(a=273467,b=68520182,same=3,total=8,rate=0.375,tier="L4-实锤",days=0.003,score=3.2)]
print(pairData)
```
